decisions.quote: Unexpectedly, we found only weak evidence for quantity discrimination skills and no effect of the type of stimuli. Only some subjects reliably selected the larger quantity in some, but not all quantity pairs. These findings are not only in contrast to the previously conducted study on monkeys, but also to other studies on horses.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly conclude that finding no effect of stimulus type and weak quantity discrimination is in contrast to Schmitt and Fischer's (2011) monkey study, and under the codebook a failed prerequisite discrimination that prevents testing the downstream mental-representation mechanism is coded as failed rather than uninformative.

corrected_value.title: Horses (Equus caballus) select the greater of two quantities in small numerical contrasts

decisions.reason: This is an omitted target: the paper explicitly conducts a conceptual replication of Uller and Lewis (2009) to test the robustness of horses' quantity discrimination across methodologies and concludes that its findings are in contrast to that study.
